 Garner and Affleck were married for a decade and share three children.
 Raechal Shewfelt Sat, November 7, 2026 at 9:00 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Jennifer Garner in July 2026
Credit: Christopher Polk/Deadline via Getty Key Points
 Jennifer Garner explained in a new interview with Ina Garten that she'd taken a memorable trip to Europe with ex-husband Ben Affleck when their kids were small.
 The family had accompanied Affleck to London while he portrayed Batman in a movie.
 The exes were married in 2005 and announced their split a decade later.
 Jennifer Garner has fond memories of the City of Light.
 The Dallas Buyers Club star recounted a trip she took there with her kids during her marriage to Ben Affleck in a Wednesday interview on Happy Hour With Ina Garten .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "When my kids were really little, I went to Paris," Garner said. "Ben was shooting some Batman -ish movie in London and we went for six weeks. I took them out of school. It was the last time I really took kids out of school, but it was wonderful. It was incredible. It was so fun."
 The alum of TV's Alias and Affleck, who's played the Caped Crusader in movies including 2016's Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice and the following year's Justice League , were married in June 2005. They welcomed three kids — Violet, 20; Seraphina, 17; and Samuel, 14 — before announcing their split a decade later.
 "And part of that is that we bopped around," Garner recalled. "We went to Venice, we went to Paris."
 Ben Affleck and Jennifer Garner in 2014 
 Credit: Jeff Vespa/VF14/WireImage 
 Garner said the Food Network star had urged her to "go down the Seine in a boat," and the experience was everything she had promised.
 Advertisement Advertisement "I've done it now, every time I go," Garner said. "Every picture from that night, from that trip, the smile on my kids' faces — it was such an adventure that you gave us. "
 When she'd returned to Paris with Violet, who speaks French and was doing a program in France, Garner again turned to the cookbook author for suggestions on what to do. The recommendations were a success once more.
 "It was just the two of us," Garner said. "It was so special."
 The 13 Going on 30 star is a foodie herself, as host of her own Pretend Cooking Show on social media.
 She and Affleck have managed to stay on good terms in the years since their breakup, as the Argo star told Variety last month.
 Advertisement Advertisement "They have a great thing with their mom, for whom I'm also really, really grateful," Affleck said. "I know things will come up that are hard, and I don't want to jinx that, but this time in my life as a human being is really wonderful."
